# omics-skills 1.5.0

Version 1.5 completes the repository-wide quality backlog carried forward from v1.4, except for the explicitly deferred JGI Lakehouse work. The package contains four agents and 34 skills for Claude Code and Codex.

## Executable omics workflows

- Added fixture-backed, restartable drivers for read QC and mapping, assembly QC, gene calling, annotation, phylogenomics, pangenomes, viromics, and interdomain HGT.
- Added normalized tables for markers, family copy number, synteny, ncRNA, taxonomy, domain routing, discovery candidates, hypotheses, and intermediate reflections where relevant.
- Added reference and database manifests, checksums, fixed seeds, conditional gates, restart behavior, and scheduler-oriented command plans.
- Added executable QC checks for bin routing, ML leakage and calibration, structure-annotation inputs, FASTA curation, and scientific-evidence scoring.

## Metadata, methods, and documents

- Added LinkML extension compatibility checks and migration fixtures.
- Added opt-in license and citation generation to the bioinformatics project scaffold.
- Added Snakemake and CWL run extraction and a stricter Nextflow evidence contract.
- Added bidirectional Jupyter and marimo conversion fixtures, scientific-paper bundle fixtures, and broader EDA format coverage.

## Literature, visualization, and review

- Added expiring caches, cross-process pacing, retry behavior, and provenance metadata to the arXiv, bioRxiv, OpenAlex, and polars-dovmed clients.
- Added a pinned matplotlib export fixture and a runnable Dash application with startup and callback-performance tests.
- Added schema-validatable manuscript-review bundles and clearer routing boundaries among critique, evidence assessment, prose revision, and rebuttal drafting.
- Expanded the routing benchmark from 50 to 57 cases; all 57 pass.

## Scope and validation

The new tests validate deterministic fixtures, schemas, command planning, normalization, restart behavior, routing, and failure handling. They do not replace biological truth-set validation of external tools or databases. `jgi-lakehouse` is unchanged in this release by design.

Run `make install` after updating. The installer exposes all 34 skills and four agents.
